typography.font_pairing: Swiss Cyber-Editorial (Cabinet Grotesk / Syne for Display + Plus Jakarta Sans for Body + JetBrains Mono for UI labels)

hierarchy.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
hierarchy.eyebrow: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-cyan-400/90

hero_composition_rules.structure: Asymmetric overlay system where headline and interaction coexist cleanly

coexistence_protocol.pointer_events_rule: The orb canvas container MUST have pointer-events-none overall. ONLY the draggable orb element itself receives pointer-events-auto. Hero buttons, text, and header links remain 100% clickable and unblocked.
coexistence_protocol.layout_split: On desktop: Left column (col-span-7) holds Hero Headline, Eyebrow, CTAs, and algorithm stats. Right column (col-span-5) hosts the hero orb canvas backdrop and live valence map preview.

playground_section.subtitle: Drag the Orb across 2D Valence and Energy spectrums to shape your sonic reality in real-time.

layout.canvas_dimensions: h-[540px] md:h-[640px] rounded-3xl border border-white/10 relative overflow-hidden bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-[0_20px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]
layout.zone_grid: 2 rows x 3 columns map representation. X-axis = Valence (Unpleasant -> Pleasant), Y-axis = Energy (Relaxed -> Intense)

interactive_elements.mood_orb: Gradiated 80px sphere with outer diffuse glow (blur 24px) that shifts color continuously based on nearest zone center interpolation
interactive_elements.now_playing_chip: Floating glassmorphism pill showing current track, artist, BPM, key, and a mini reactive equalizer visualizer
interactive_elements.zone_snap_lock: Double-clicking or dropping inside a zone snaps orb gently with spring motion, locking the gradient & triggering a track switch animation
interactive_elements.waveform_line: Interactive SVG / HTML Canvas line that runs horizontally across the playground floor, adjusting frequency (Energy) and amplitude curve smooth (Valence)

waveform_treatment.rendering: Sine wave series with perlin noise modulation
waveform_treatment.energy_mapping: Higher Energy = higher frequency (more rapid wave oscillations) + faster horizontal scroll speed
waveform_treatment.valence_mapping: Higher Valence = smoother, harmonic peaks; Lower Valence = erratic, jagged, saw-like noise spikes

glow_and_light_language.style: Volumetric neon light bleed on ultra-dark matte surface
glow_and_light_language.orb_light: Multi-layer radial gradients with drop-shadow(0 0 35px var(--glow-color))
glow_and_light_language.cursor_trail: Subtle particle dust lingering behind the orb when dragged quickly

mobile_simplification_rules.touch_interactions: Full touch gesture drag support with Framer Motion dragConstraints and dragElastic={0.15}
mobile_simplification_rules.mobile_canvas_optimization: Reduce particle count by 50% and reduce canvas resolution DPR to 1.0 on screens < 768px for 60fps performance
mobile_simplification_rules.fallback_tap_zones: Show 6 explicit pill buttons above/below map on mobile so users can tap a mood directly if dragging is awkward
mobile_simplification_rules.layout_stacking: Stack map and track detail vertical on small screens without losing visual fidelity

accessibility_and_keyboard.keyboard_controls: Focusable orb handle via Tab key; Arrow keys move orb by 5% step; Keys 1-6 snap directly to Focus (1), Hype (2), Chill (3), Melancholy (4), Euphoric (5), Late Night (6)
accessibility_and_keyboard.screen_reader: aria-valuenow for Valence and Energy; live aria-live region announcing mood label and track changes
accessibility_and_keyboard.prefers_reduced_motion: Disable continuous idle float and smooth snap orb without bouncy springs when reduced motion is requested

component_hierarchy: Navbar (Sticky glass header with brand logo, Vibe Playground jump button, and CTA)
HeroSection (Headline, value proposition, algorithm pill, mini interactive Mood Orb preview)
VibePlaygroundSection (#the-vibe-playground canvas, 6 mood zones, draggable orb, dynamic track chip, audio waveform)
AlgorithmComparison (Why static 20-song rotation fails vs context-aware Vibe vector matching)
FeatureBentoGrid (Tetris layout showcasing Real-time Biometrics, Context Sensing, Seamless DAW Export, Collaborative Vibes)
InteractiveAudioPreview (Curated track stems browser with interactive mood tag filters)
TestimonialsAndMetrics (99.4% vibe accuracy, 4.2M tracks indexed, real producer quotes)
CTASection (Join the Vibe Private Beta waitlist with animated pulse CTA input)
Footer (Navigation links, social links, system status indicator)
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the landing page in React JS using Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Ensure section id='the-vibe-playground' exists directly after the hero section as requested.
Make sure the hero orb and playground orb are draggable on both desktop mouse and mobile touch.
Ensure the hero orb container uses pointer-events-none with pointer-events-auto ONLY on the orb itself so hero text buttons remain 100% clickable.
Interpolate colors smoothly between the 6 mood zones based on Euclidean distance to zone centers.
Add test IDs (`data-testid`) to all interactive elements as outlined in data_testid_rules.
Do NOT import Inter or Roboto for headers or display text. Use Cabinet Grotesk / Syne or high-character sans.
Ensure dark background (#0B0B10) with vibrant glowing accents.
